# Mediabunny 1.61.3

Unmodified browser bundle from https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.61.3
Upstream source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.61.3
License: MPL-2.0; see LICENSE. Bundle renamed from .mjs to .js for static-server MIME compatibility.
Loaded locally by Video Compare for source audio decoding and deterministic MP4 remuxing.
No external CDN is used at runtime.
